mechanism_relevant_findings: Oxides dissolve protons that become mobile at high temperatures resulting in proton conduction.
Effects of grain boundaries and trapping on proton transport are outlined.
arrhenius_vtf_findings: Proton conduction mechanisms are discussed with a basis in the thermodynamics of proton dissolution.
